content: AI test-case generation from source code analyzes function signatures/dependencies/control flow to surface edge and negative cases beyond happy-path; multi-agent/coverage-guided search approaches specifically separate 'edge case discovery' from 'test authoring' as two phases, since correct-looking tests are trivial once real edge cases are identified. All sources stress mandatory human review of generated edge/negative cases before treating them as ground truth -- relevant since v1 output is human-reviewed reports, not auto-applied code.
